items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Edward Johnson, that's what he was named... He was playing saxophone. He was playing clarinet.

ctx.x: I guess I would find another one.
No, let me see what's his name again. Edward. He works now by Maison Blanche. Can't call around, his name is Edward.
We'll ask Pickett. Yeah, we'll see him someday.
